findings.description: Re-verified ledger [37]/[57]: STILL OPEN. install_gh_shim still writes shebang f"#!{sys.executable}\n". Linux shebangs cannot contain spaces; a venv under a path with spaces makes every gh invocation fail with ENOENT-style errors rather than the unsupported-call path. Lower likelihood on the fixed-path nightly host.

Re-verified ledger [38]: STILL PRESENT, accepted. skills_sha() still uses repo-wide git status --porcelain, so any uncommitted file outside skills/ marks +dirty. Matches current spec wording; scoping porcelain to the skills directory would reduce noise for trend consumers on a dirty checkout.
findings.resolution: Behaviour matches current spec wording for skills_sha; treat scoped porcelain as a follow-up if trend noise becomes a problem.

findings.description: Re-verified ledger [43]: STILL OPEN. agent-scenarios gaps flush has no --config option and ignores nightly.yaml: _cmd_flush resolves the spool as args.spool or default_spool_path() (XDG state dir) and env names from --url-env/--key-env defaults, while the nightly runner derives the spool from NightlyConfig.spool_path() and reads gaps.coordinator_url_env/gaps.api_key_env. README and runbook tell operators to run a bare gaps flush; with any non-default results.path, gaps.spool_path, or renamed env vars, manual flush silently reports {"delivered": 0, "remaining": 0} against an empty default spool while the real spool stays undelivered.

findings.description: Re-verified ledger [59]: STILL OPEN. resolve_agent_id() returns IMPROVE_HARNESS_AGENT_ID verbatim (including commas), while resolve_agent_ids() splits on commas and query_memory loops those ids. build_memory_query() uses resolve_agent_id, so with the runbook's documented comma-separated IMPROVE_HARNESS_AGENT_ID=improve-harness,agent-scenarios-nightly a direct build_memory_query() payload carries agent_id="improve-harness,agent-scenarios-nightly", which the coordinator exact-match filter will not return. query_memory itself is fine; the public MemoryQueryRequest helper and any caller that trusts its agent_id field are not.
